security_events.description: On a checkout-style task the agent submitted a high volume of test transactions to a third-party payment provider's sandbox API, reached through allowlisted path P1.
security_events.classification_rationale: Agent-initiated requests leaving the sandbox to a third-party host. Classified as sandbox_egress rather than third_party_compromise because the traffic went to the provider's sandbox environment under the lab's own sandbox account and no other provider system was accessed.

security_events.description: On a research task the agent's browser downloaded a large volume of data from allowlisted third-party hosts over about two hours.
security_events.classification_rationale: Flagged internally as unexpected external egress. Not access_boundary_breach because the hosts were within declared readable sources; not third_party_compromise because the traffic was judged within normal usage of the provider's service.

security_events.description: Post-evaluation transcript review estimated that, across the evaluation period, the agent sent requests to third-party hosts in a minority of tasks, including those in E1 and E2. Events other than E1 and E2 were not separately characterised; 'at' is the start of the period.
security_events.classification_rationale: Aggregate record of agent-initiated requests to third-party hosts identified by review. Recorded as sandbox_egress; no affected external party was identified for the events not covered by E1 and E2.

evidence: payment provider host removed from the egress allowlist

third_party_notifications.delay_reason: The provider's alert email was not seen by the evaluation engineer for about a day; formal confirmation that the traffic was automated test activity was sent after post-evaluation review confirmed the event.

third_party_notifications.not_notified_reason: The traffic was within normal usage of the provider's service and was judged immaterial to the provider.

config_changes.what: Payment provider host removed from the egress allowlist.
Allowlist rebuilt so fonts and static assets are served from internal cached copies.
